authorityRules.cwms-observed-only: USACE CWMS is an optional water-data (observed) plane. It is NOT a replacement for USGS observations or hydraulic-model results.
authorityRules.fema-nfhl-vs-indiana-bafm: FEMA NFHL (effective) and Indiana DNR BAFM are DISTINCT authority planes. BAFM is a state best-available product and must NEVER be silently promoted to FEMA NFHL authority.
authorityRules.live-data-policy: All live fetches are explicit-caller only (button-initiated). No auto-polling, no background refresh, no page-load fetch.
authorityRules.nsi-not-survey: USACE NSI is consequence/structure reference data. Its attributes are modeled/estimated; it is NOT survey truth and carries no regulatory weight.
authorityRules.wells-location-quality: IDNR water-well locations mix field-located, geocoded, and PLSS-estimated points. Estimated locations are NOT survey-grade geometry and must be labeled as such.
